subject: Urgent: FinScale latency surge — audit evidence & log preservation request
messages:
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@finscale.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@finscale.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 22:45:00 -0700
Subject: [FinScale] Production latency spike + request for preserved logs and chain-of-custody

Ava —

We saw a sustained latency and elevated 5xx rate across several routes in our production traffic to Redwood between 2027-04-19T03:10Z and 2027-04-19T05:05Z. Our SREs are asking for a preserved evidence bundle (logs, request IDs, sampling of request payloads where allowed, and a chain-of-custody manifest) to complete our internal post-incident review and to share with our compliance team.

Specifically we need:
- Full request/response logs for our tenant for 2027-04-19T02:50Z to 2027-04-19T06:00Z (UTC)
- Any service-side error traces and stackwalks correlated to the above times
- A manifest describing who pulled the logs, when, and any redaction performed
- Confirmation of retention policy and whether any logs were truncated or rotated during that window

Please advise cadence and ETA. We may need an exec-level brief for our CISO and VP Eng — looping them in if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Ops Manager, FinScale

---
Attachments: none
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@finscale.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [FinScale] Production latency spike + request for preserved logs and chain-of-custody

Sarah —

Acknowledged and sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as an incident escalation and will preserve the requested artifacts immediately. High-level plan:

1) Marcus will extract the raw tenant logs and error traces and create a read-only evidence bundle.
2) We'll produce a chain-of-custody manifest that lists extraction steps, hashes, and personnel.
3) We will provide sanitized request payload samples where permitted by your policy (we'll confirm fields that need to be redacted).
4) Expect a first delivery (manifest + metadata + summary) within 24 hours, and the full evidence bundle within 48 hours.

For now, can you confirm the minimum set of PI/fields we should redact for payload samples (or point me to your internal data handling policy)? That will speed up the pipeline.

Looping in Marcus and Monica to own extraction and customer communication. If you want an exec sync, propose 10:30am PT today.

- Ava
Ava Chen | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [FinScale] Production latency spike + request for preserved logs and chain-of-custody

Team —

Summary of what we can and will pull (technical note for the manifest):
- Sources: inference runtime logs (per-host), API gateway access logs, routing logs, and the autoscaler timeline for the cluster that handled FinScale tenant-id: fs_tenant_992.
- Window: 2027-04-19T02:50Z -> 2027-04-19T06:00Z UTC (will include 1 hour pre/post buffer to capture warmup/cleanup)
- Format: gzipped tarball (redwood-logs-20270419.tar.gz) with separate index files and SHA256 sums for each file.
- Redaction: we will NOT include full user prompt text or full customer payloads unless explicitly requested and approved by FinScale. For samples we will supply field-level samples with prompt/response hashed and sensitive fields redacted.
- Chain-of-custody: I will produce chain-of-custody-manifest.txt listing extraction host, operator account, extraction commands, checksums, and storage location (S3-presigned read-only link with 30-day TTL).
- Legal hold: We'll mark the bundle with a legal-hold tag to prevent automatic rotation during your review.

Operational notes:
- Extraction commands will run under a restricted incident-runbook account (incident-run@redwood.com).
- We will generate an HMAC for the tarball and record it in the manifest.
- If FinScale requests raw payloads, we'll require either a mutual NDA amendment or a redaction/field whitelist.

ETA: Preliminary manifest + metadata by 2027-04-20T11:00Z; full bundle by 2027-04-21T02:00Z.

I'll mark this as high priority and start extraction now.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Subject: Re: [FinScale] Production latency spike + request for preserved logs and chain-of-custody

Sarah —

Thanks for raising this; wanted to set expectations from a CS perspective for FinScale leadership:
- We'll provide an incident briefing deck summarizing timeline, root-cause hypotheses, and mitigation steps alongside the evidence bundle.
- If your CISO requests a short exec phone call, Marcus and I are available at 10:30am PT today. We will not share raw prompts or PII unless we have explicit sign-off.
- If your legal team wants to ingest the bundle, please point us to a secure transfer mechanism (preferred: your SFTP or an encrypted presigned S3 link under an NDA).

I'll draft the customer-facing incident summary once Marcus confirms the manifest.

Regards,
Monica Patel | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Delivery plan: FinScale evidence bundle + exec brief 

Sarah —

Per the ops notes below, next steps and deliverables:

- 11:00 PT (now): Preliminary manifest and metadata (includes list of files, SHA256 sums, extraction operator) — attached as chain-of-custody-manifest.txt (attached).
- 15:00 PT today: Customer-facing incident summary deck (PDF) with timeline + high-level RCA hypotheses.
- 02:00 PT tomorrow: Full read-only evidence bundle as a presigned S3 link (redwood-logs-20270419.tar.gz). Link will be HMAC-signed and TTL-limited; we will retain a copy under legal hold for 90 days.

Please confirm: do we proceed with the presigned S3 link as the transfer mechanism? Also confirm any additional redaction rules (fields or regexes) for payload samples.

For exec outreach: Marcus + Monica + I can join a 30-minute sync at 10:30am PT today if you confirm.

Thanks,
Ava

Attachments: chain-of-custody-manifest.txt (attached), audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx (attached)
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@finscale.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@finscale.com>, legal@finscale.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delivery plan: FinScale evidence bundle + exec brief

Ava/Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the manifest. Presigned S3 link is fine — please encrypt the bundle at rest and provide the HMAC and SHA256 sums in the manifest. Our legal wants to review the manifest and the redaction approach before ingesting any samples.

We confirm the following redaction rules for samples: redact any credit-card like strings, IP addresses, and full prompt texts; fields that can be shared: request_id, timestamp, route, status_code, latency_ms, and anonymized prompt hashes. We'll sign any required amendment to the data sharing addendum; legal@finscale.com will coordinate.

We'd like the exec sync at 10:30am PT. See you then.

— Sarah
